name: Vendor Invoice Approval Agent
businessPurpose: Speed up vendor invoice processing by matching invoices to purchase orders and paying approved vendors.

logging.destination: Application logs, not yet forwarded to the SIEM

killSwitch.description: Manual: the on-call engineer disables the agent's service account. No tested runbook.

description: Reads vendor invoices from an email inbox, including attachments, extracts payment details, matches them against purchase orders in the ERP, and approves and initiates wire transfers of up to $25,000 without human review. It keeps a memory of vendor history to spot anomalies, but that memory store is shared across all vendor accounts with no per-vendor separation.
